name: Make the useProfiles gate-hint mutation regression terminate
description: The existing useUpdateProfileName regression for preserving first-Mentor gate hints hangs indefinitely both alone and in the full use-profiles test file, preventing a complete mobile verification verdict.
acceptanceCriteria: 1. `preserves first-Mentor gate hints when the PATCH response omits them` terminates and passes in isolation without `--forceExit`. 2. The complete `apps/mobile/src/hooks/use-profiles.test.ts` suite terminates and passes within its normal test budget. 3. The regression still proves cached `conversationLanguageConfirmed` and `isCurrentUser` hints survive a PATCH response that omits them. 4. No fake-timer, query invalidation, mutation, or open-handle residue leaks into neighboring tests. 5. Record red/green evidence for the isolated test and full file.
